storyCards.headline: Pinball Wizard: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Who's "Pinball Wizard" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

Pinball Wizard was released in 1979.

Album: The Kids Are Alright (Soundtrack) (1979).
